name: thrombospondin type 1 domain containing 7B

function.text: THSD7B is the approved symbol for thrombospondin type 1 domain containing 7B. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in actin cytoskeleton organization.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Glioblastoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: THSD7B encodes thrombospondin type 1 domain containing 7B. Its functions include actin cytoskeleton organization.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving THSD7B have been reported in glioblastoma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
